question: From which finger base and in what order should the hand-rosary counting proceed?
premises: Counting begins at the ring-finger base.
It proceeds in sequence including the little finger.
inference: The hand-rosary count starts from the base of the ring finger and proceeds in order.
uncertainties: The full sequence of fingers is continued in the next verse.
plain_english: And starting from the base of the ring finger, proceeding in order to the little finger.
